annotations.text:
Boarding wall — the cabinet elevation as the room board.

Each unit is drawn as the cabinet the maker is building: cream carcass, slatted vent capsule, glass door on hinges, grey arch, pale-green litter tray, porthole panels on Zones 2 and 4.

Only the GLASS takes the status colour. The cabinet never changes — which is how the wall reads in life, since you look through the door to see who is home.

Rooms are buttons: click one to open it in the rail. The date strip repaints the wall for any of the next 14 days.

Still drawn from DATA — zone plus col/row/span — not a traced SVG. The furniture is a per-kind recipe, so the wall stays rearrangeable without a deploy.

41 boarding units + 6 staging cubbies:
Z1 10 irregular (two double-height ends) · Z2 9 porthole · Z3 18 standard · Z4 4 suites.

Same cabinet vocabulary, one bank at a time. Every target 44pt+.

No fake status bar — the real one renders on top.
